summary: Changes the Python signature of Path.Path.getCycleTime from four arguments (hFeed, vFeed, hRapid, vRapid) to three (hFeed, vFeed, rapid) and makes the estimate honour per-command F values, which also changes the numbers shown by operations' CycleTime property without changing any property, control or default.

pages.reason: Path.pyi / PathPyImp.cpp: Path.getCycleTime(h_feed, v_feed, h_rapid, v_rapid) becomes getCycleTime(h_feed, v_feed, rapid) and command F parameters now override the arguments; any call example or method listing under The Path object with four arguments is now wrong (if the page does not list the method, no edit is needed)
Path/Op/Util.py hunk only updates the internal call in getCycleTimeEstimate to the new three-argument signature; the source map's Util.py -> area.adoc mapping is unrelated to this file's content

unmapped: src/Mod/CAM/Path/Op/Util.py (mapped to misc/area.adoc, but it holds operation helpers such as getCycleTimeEstimate; a better map target would be the operation pages' CycleTime property or reference/scripting.adoc)
